dialogues.speaker: Charmian
dialogues.text: Forgive my honesty, Intef, but we reached this point in our debate because you had to mention the Goat King.

dialogues.speaker: Intef
dialogues.text: Of course, of course. And I agree with your assessment of him as a treacherous official. None would deny his role in King Deshret's rulership had two sides.

dialogues.speaker: Intef
dialogues.text: Good and evil — he was both. That is the reality of it, is it not? His ambition came from his power and wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Charmian
dialogues.text: Indeed, and compared to Lord Hermanubis, all impure souls should know themselves filthy and shamed. But that matters not. I merely contend that the Goat King is nothing before the Crocodile King.

dialogues.speaker: Intef
dialogues.text: The Crocodile King, superior? Al-Ahmar above, grant this person eyes to see the many texts we have collected here!

dialogues.speaker: Charmian
dialogues.text: And what of them? Do any of them say that they were of equal worth?

dialogues.speaker: Intef
dialogues.text: None say that they were not.

dialogues.speaker: Charmian
dialogues.text: *sigh* Come on, you've got to listen to me...
